$comment: Claude Code-style hook configuration for this memory folder. Events are the real Claude Code event names (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop). They only fire if an agent runtime that understands this format is driving the folder; the git pre-commit hook in hooks/pre_commit_log.py is the always-on equivalent.

hooks.description: Print SESSION_STATE.md + newest log entry so a resumed session starts with memory loaded
Blocks history-rewriting commands in this repo (force-push, reset --hard, branch deletion). Exit code 2 blocks the call and feeds the message back.
Appends every Bash command to memory/command-history.md so the raw trail survives outside the chat transcript
At the end of a turn: warn (to stderr) if the memory folder has uncommitted changes
